child.label: Relationship Choices & Habits
child.description: Questions about what the answerer does, prefers, or thinks is right in a committed relationship, such as marriage, chores, jealousy, phones, exes, arguments, breakups, and attachment style.
child.not_for: Ratings of how many people would agree with a stated rule of thumb about partners (use Relationship Rules of Thumb).
examples: Should couples live together before marriage?
Do you tend to get jealous in relationships?

child.label: Relationship Rules of Thumb
child.description: Questions about how many people would agree with a general rule of thumb about partners, spouses, or romantic relationships, rated from "practically no one" to "practically everyone".
child.not_for: Questions about what the answerer personally does, prefers, or would do in a relationship (use Relationship Choices & Habits).
examples: How many people would agree: "Cheating on a partner is wrong"?
How many people would agree: "It is important to be honest with your partner"?
